description: MainActivity.java for an Android application demonstrating voice interaction features, including service binding, button event handling, and audio playback.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity that manages voice recognition and audio playback functions, binds to a service, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches click listeners to UI buttons.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Binds the activity to the voice interaction service when the activity starts.

methods.name: attachClickListener
methods.description: Attaches a click listener to a button that plays audio data from the service.

methods.name: playAudio
methods.description: Creates and manages an AudioTrack object to play a byte array as audio.
